biography: • Source and secure high‑value data center land for hyperscalers, operators, Neoclouds and next‑gen cloud platforms — from first conversation to commercial close. • De‑risk global markets with end‑to‑end assessment across geopolitics, power availability, grid stability, fibre routes, planning, and permitting. • Unlock maximum developer returns by transforming raw land into bankable, investor‑ready powered, permitted, and masterplanned data center campuses. • Drive commercial outcomes by structuring dark shell, powered shell, core & shell, and turnkey solutions aligned to hyperscaler procurement models. • Accelerate time‑to‑market with proven playbooks for greenfield and brownfield development across mature and emerging markets. • Bridge the gap between utilities, landowners, and cloud demand, ensuring every site is positioned for scale, speed, and premium exit value. • Deliver global reach at hyperscale speed, with experience across 45 countries and a track record of bringing 5GW+ of powered land to market. • Create competitive tension and uplift by packaging land, power, and permitting into compelling, ready‑to‑execute opportunities for buyers. • Guide developers through the full commercial journey, from initial feasibility to structuring, pricing, negotiation, and go‑to‑market. • Translate complex technical constraints into clear commercial levers, enabling faster decisions and higher‑value transactions
